content.value_statement: Command palettes often fail on keyboard flow, filtering, and render stability. This skill provides React patterns for navigation, focus, scrolling, and stable command registration.
actual_capabilities: Explains a wrapper component pattern that mounts keyboard effects only while the palette is open.
Shows React keyboard handling for ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, and Escape.
Demonstrates scrollIntoView patterns that keep selected items visible.
Describes filtering by labels, shortcuts, and numeric identifiers.
Provides stable reference patterns to prevent command re-registration loops.
Includes a testing checklist for command palette behavior.
limitations: Focuses on React and TypeScript examples, not other UI frameworks.
Does not provide a packaged component or installable library.
Does not cover accessibility roles beyond keyboard behavior.
Does not test code inside the user application.

use_cases.title: Add a Cmd+K Palette
use_cases.description: Build a React command palette with open, close, selection, and execution behavior.

use_cases.title: Standardize Keyboard Behavior
use_cases.description: Define consistent arrow navigation, Enter selection, Escape closing, and scroll behavior for shared UI components.

use_cases.title: Fix Render Loop Bugs
use_cases.description: Stabilize command objects, icons, handlers, and registration logic in an existing palette.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Navigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner implementation for a new palette.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add Cmd+K keyboard navigation to my React command palette. Include open, close, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, and Escape behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Keep Selection Visible
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate improvement for long command lists.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to keep the selected command visible while users navigate a long React command palette with arrow keys.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Command Filtering
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate filtering for labels and shortcuts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to improve filtering in my command palette. Match command labels, shortcut text such as g d, and numeric issue or pull request identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Stabilize Registration Logic
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced debugging for repeated registration or render loops.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to diagnose and fix command palette re-registration loops. Review my command objects, icons, handlers, dependency arrays, and cleanup behavior.

output_examples.input: I need a React command palette that opens with Cmd+K and supports arrow navigation.
output_examples.output: The assistant provides a wrapper structure, keyboard event flow, selected index rules, and a checklist for open, close, and execute behavior.

output_examples.input: My selected item leaves the visible scroll area when users press ArrowDown.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends a selected item ref strategy and explains when to use nearest scroll alignment.

output_examples.input: My commands keep re-registering and cause repeated renders.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies unstable icons, actions, or command arrays and suggests stable references with label-based change detection.

best_practices: Mount keyboard effects only while the palette is open.
Reset the selected index whenever the filter query changes.
Use stable icons and handlers before registering commands.
anti_patterns: Registering global keyboard listeners while the palette is closed.
Recreating command icons and actions on every render.
Using setTimeout for focus when autoFocus is sufficient.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build React Cmd+K command palettes with reliable keyboard navigation, filtering, scrolling, and command registration.

faq.question: Does it include a ready-made component?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns and examples that you adapt to your application.

faq.question: Can it help with infinite re-render issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains stable command references, stable icons, handler memoization, and label-based change detection.

faq.question: Which keyboard behavior is covered?
faq.answer: It covers Cmd+K or Ctrl+K opening patterns, arrow navigation, Enter execution, Escape closing, and selected item visibility.

faq.question: Does it require a specific UI library?
faq.answer: No. The examples use React patterns that can be adapted to most component libraries.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
